content.short: The first sub-suit nautical theme-based NFT art collection on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
United and inspired by the popular first-person shooter 'Bioshock', we (the team) wanted our project to be meaningful to us, so we decided to base it around the same game that brought us together. This is where the inspiration for the sub-suit/nautical theme of Deep Divers comes from.

Season 1 consists of 2,000 unique arts randomly generated for the community to collect, including utility for Season 2. No two Divers are alike, each one generated from a selection of 58 hand-drawn variations.

You can find out more about Deep Divers by joining our amazing community over on Twitter and Discord.
